title: 美联储理事联盟：力挺沃什，国债曲线失真？
speaker: Danielle DiMartino Booth

segments.en: And I think as long as he has that coalition of permanent voting Federal Reserve Board governors that he's going to stand his ground.
segments.zh: 我认为只要他拥有常任投票的美联储理事联盟，他就会坚持自己的立场。

segments.en: So I actually believe that we're going to see a whole not just in September for the rest of the year.
segments.zh: 所以我实际上认为，我们将在9月乃至今年剩余时间看到整体情况。

segments.en: We touched on what Scott Bessense and that side of the room is doing.
segments.zh: 我们提到了斯科特·贝森特那边在做什么。

segments.en: I want to get your thoughts on whether or not you think that works, whether you, I mean, certainly when you look at the absolute level on Treasury yields in the shape of the curb, it doesn't look like this is an economy that's slowing down.
segments.zh: 我想听听你的看法，你是否认为这有效。当然，当你看到国债收益率曲线的绝对水平时，这看起来不像是一个正在放缓的经济。

segments.en: And I'm wondering whether Scott Bessense, they're simply trying to abstract maybe some of the premium and supply issues that are hounding the Treasury market.
segments.zh: 我想知道斯科特·贝森特是否只是在试图抽象一些困扰国债市场的溢价和供应问题。

segments.en: In fact, the only one I want to ask is do you think the exercise to cap yields will help and do you think the Treasury curve is representative currently of the underlying economy?
segments.zh: 事实上，我只想问，你认为限制收益率的操作会有帮助吗？你认为国债曲线目前是否代表了潜在经济？

segments.en: So I think right now the Treasury curve is exaggerating the underlying health of the economy given the disinflationary winds that we're seeing blowing that says you are absolutely correct.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，鉴于我们看到的通缩风，国债曲线目前夸大了经济的潜在健康状况，你说得完全正确。
